record.title: Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
record.description: The cinematic action-adventure that forced Lara Croft to grow from an inexperienced young woman into a hardened survivor has been re-built for next-gen consoles, featuring an obsessively detailed Lara and a stunningly lifelike world. record.title: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
record.description: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream expands Nintendo’s Mii-driven life-simulation formula on Nintendo Switch. Players create or collect Mii characters, customize profiles, build an island community, place shops and facilities, follow daily Mii News, manage relationships, and influence the island without directly controlling every event. Nintendo lists the title as Nintendo Switch software with Nintendo Switch 2 backward compatibility, not as a native Switch 2 Edition.
